The 320-byte scratch stride is a bounded, distinct cache-layout test; cache indexing is unknown, and the prior 272-byte result gives no evidence for this stride. TA and TT add timed full-input transposes, making them lower priority. All effects remain unmeasured; correctness, paired controls, and the fixed promotion gate decide whether any candidate advances.
